_comment: Reusable SFX in ~/.agents/skills/elevenlabs/assets/sounds/. Used as tick/timer beds in the gaps of guess-the-word style videos. Paths are relative to $HOME/code/_shared/medias/sounds/.

clock-tac-soft.mp3.notes: Soft tac-tac clock. Current default guess-pause bed (trim to ~2.3s).

guess-pause-tick.mp3.notes: Quiet tick isolated from the original @elodie.french TikTok. Low level (~-48dB).
